title: Desk Guidance: Principal Relief on the Cash Pickup Reactivation Fee
content:
## Rule

The fee for reactivating an expired Cash Pickup pickup carries a principal relief. The relief follows the principal collected on the transfer, meaning the total of the funds received for it as recorded on the transfer's money movements.

| Principal collected on the transfer (USD) | Relief taken off the reactivation fee (USD) |
|---|---|
| at least 1000.00 | 0.30 |
| at least 500.00 but less than 1000.00 | 0.15 |
| less than 500.00 | nothing |

The relief is taken off the reactivation fee as a whole, meaning the tier's fee together with anything added to it. The fee never falls below zero, and the result is rounded half up to the cent.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical principals collected)

| Principal collected | Relief |
|---|---|
| 499.99 | nothing |
| 500.00 | 0.15 |
| 999.99 | 0.15 |
| 1000.00 | 0.30 |
| 2500.00 | 0.30 |
